author: UmbreonMessiah
body:
This is a very small suggestion, but I feel it would make Avicus just that little bit better. When the game first ends, your inventory switches to the compass, blaze powder and stuff right away. I think it would be nice if you put a small delay on that, as I have had countless time where is I was bridging, therefor I was holding my left mouse button, and then the game ends, and I end up holding that click on the leave game. Then, it makes me "download terrain" like 10 times, which for me sometimes takes a minute of just sitting there. It's really annoying. If you guys put just a little delay so that doesn't happen, I think it'd be great. Anyways, hope you consider this, it's small, but small things do add up.

                     Thanks,
                           Hyper
